assumption: Caregivers will act on refill reminders sent by SMS.
experiment_constraint: SMS content must not contain health details.

assumption: Clinic administrators can bulk-import a patient roster without assisted setup.
experiment_constraint: Use synthetic rosters only.

assumption: New patients can finish onboarding without live support.
experiment_constraint: Panel participants must be adults.

assumption: Independent pharmacies will accept an emailed pickup token.
experiment_constraint: No message may resemble a real prescription.

assumption: Patients will connect a wearable to share adherence signals.
experiment_constraint: Only synthetic wearable data may be used.

assumption: Caregivers will pay $6 per month for coordination features.
experiment_constraint: No real payment may be captured.

assumption: Clinicians will review a weekly queue of adherence-risk alerts.
experiment_constraint: Use fictional patient cases only.

assumption: Patients will switch their preferred language during an active flow.
experiment_constraint: Prototype supports Spanish and Mandarin only.

assumption: Rural patients can upload an insurance image on a slow connection.
experiment_constraint: Use synthetic insurance cards; cap network at 1 Mbps.

assumption: Patients will complete explicit consent before enabling family sharing.
experiment_constraint: Privacy review is required; do not enable real sharing.

assumption: Small employers will sponsor a population dashboard.
experiment_constraint: No employee-level data may be shown.

assumption: Patients will complete a symptom check-in three times per week.
experiment_constraint: Prompts may run only inside the research sandbox.

assumption: Nurses will rely on automatically translated visit summaries.
experiment_constraint: Translations must be labeled draft and use fictional cases.

assumption: Returning patients will choose a passkey instead of a one-time code.
experiment_constraint: Use test accounts and lab devices only.

assumption: Patients need dark mode to continue evening sessions.
experiment_constraint: Visual prototype only.

assumption: Patients will export their history as a PDF.
experiment_constraint: Exports must contain synthetic data.

assumption: Clinics require custom branding before inviting patients.
experiment_constraint: Do not publish branded pages.

assumption: Support agents will use suggested replies for routine cases.
experiment_constraint: Fictional support transcripts only.

assumption: Patients will share adherence streak badges with family.
experiment_constraint: Sharing remains inside the research sandbox.

assumption: Clinic administrators will schedule monthly audit-log exports.
experiment_constraint: Audit rows must be synthetic.
